notes.title: Final Update: The Anniversary Update is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

I'm happy to announce the Anniversary Update for Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise is now live!

This update adds a variation of every single map in the game called "Blank World" - it's a completely white canvas of [i]every map[/i] currently available in Bombing!! 2! Now you can paint your whole world however you want it entirely from top to bottom. I've also added a Bombing!! bundle to Steam, where you can now get both Bombing!! games at a discounted price.

On another note, as we've hit one whole year since Bombing!! 2's release, I also wanted to give the heads up that will likely be the last major content update for Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise. It's been so fun to roll out new worlds and ideas into the game, and see all the wild stuff people have been creating. While updates and fixes will will undoubtedly continue to happen, they're likely going to be much smaller and contained in scale as I shift my focus to new games and creations.

I'd also like to extend my gratitude for everyone who has played the game, made some cool art, and especially those who have shared their art to the community. It's been a real treat to see so many people enjoying my game, and I always love checking up on all the amazing art and ideas everyone has been putting out into the world.

If you've enjoyed Bombing!! 2 and the updates I've rolled out for the game, please be sure to leave it a review and share it with your friends, it helps a lot! And as always, if you're interested in keeping tabs on the games I'm making in the future, check out [url=https://discord.com/invite/xJTrVwa2g4]the community Discord[/url]!

Anyway, never stop making cool art, and I hope to see you in Graffiti Paradise. :)
- Devon

notes.title: New Content Update: The Skatepark!
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

The Skatepark Map update to Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise is now live!

Take a break from all those "kickflips" and "Pop Shove-its" the kids are doing these days, and paint some sick pieces all over the ramps and buildings nestled deep in downtown Graffiti Paradise. If you've unlocked the rappel there's a couple nice high up spots there too... 👀

Happy painting!
- Devon

notes.title: New Content Update: The Museum!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays, Artists!

As a little holiday treat, the Museum update to Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise is now live!

You'll find a new map called "Museum" with a few classic art pieces! It would be a shame if someone were to...paint them 👀 There's also a bustling freeway nearby, with a few choice vehicles to plant your art all over.

Have fun!
- Devon

notes.title: New Content Update: HIllside!
notes.content:
Hello Artists!

The Hillside content update is live and a new area in Graffiti Paradise has been unlocked! Hillside is a quaint little slice of a scenic port district that features narrow alleys, clustered rooftops and new places to spray up your work.

Additionally a new tool can be unlocked in your roster; the Paint Gun! Featuring a water setting, it allows you to paint in those tough to reach areas and make more of a mess all over the world!

Happy painting!
- Devon

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

The Quality of Life update for Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise is now live!


Here's a list of the changes and additions found in the update:
[list]
[i][*] Partial keyboard control remapping
[*] Collectible UI Indicators in the travel screen*
[*] Improvements to alpha value interpolation
[*] Rappel point visibility improvements
[*] Additional rappel points added to the level
[*] Aim reticle added to all tools
[*] Save Button to allow saving without leaving a level
[*] Experimental locked painting mode**
[*] Minor bug fixes and geometry adjustments[/i]
[/list]
[i]* These icons will appear for users who have already cleared a level prior to this update only [i]after[/i] they have loaded into the level.
** Please note that the locked painting mode is experimental and may not play nicely with all the game's systems as designed, but is there for users to play around with![/i]


Happy painting!
- Devon

notes.title: Hotfix: Global Mixer Setting Issues
notes.content: Fixed an issue where some users were experiencing bad default global sound settings, resulting in audio failing to play correctly. If you experienced issues with game audio cutting out or being absent, this will likely address it.

notes.title: First Week and Future Plans!
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

Wow we're already through the first week of Bombing!! 2 being out?! Time flies!!

Thanks to everyone who has reported bugs, shared their awesome art and left feedback for the game; its all been so invaluable for development and I love seeing all the work everyone has been creating so far! :)

For the next month or so I'm planning on focusing primarily on stability fixes while I attend to some personal matters and take a short break from development. Starting in August I'm aiming to develop a patch ready with some quality of life updates and minor gameplay adjustments based on some excellent feedback and suggestions I've received from players. Once that has been rolled out I'll be setting my sights on preparing some new areas to paint, new tools, and planning some new content for y'all to play with! I've got so many cool things I want to introduce to the game, so keep your eyes on it in the coming months. 👀

Oh, also: if you've picked up the game please consider leaving a review for the game on the Store page, it helps development a lot! 

Thanks again for all your support. :)

Happy Painting!
-Devon

notes.title: BOMBING!! 2: A GRAFFITI PARADISE AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

After many months of time and effort, Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise is finally available on Steam! It's been a long road to get here, but I'm super happy to finally release the game for y'all to play! 

don't forget to check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2109570/screenshots/]Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise community pages[/url] to see what other artists are making, and to share your work for all to see!

After I take some time to bask in this huge milestone I'll slowly be shifting my production focus on to more content, tools, characters and world to paint to give players even more stuff to mess around with in the coming months.

Thank you so much again for all the support, and I look forward to seeing what you create. :)

Happy painting!

Cheers,
Devon

First off, thank you very much for your support during the Future of Play event run by GLITCH! It was awesome to see so many new players picking up the game and painting cool new pieces. 👀

[*] Removed some unused assets from the scene.
[*] Fixed Socials panel in menu sometimes not appearing properly.
[/list]

See you during NextFest!

- Devon

notes.title: Release Date, Pricing + Post-Launch Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hey Artists!

This is the rough outline for what to expect from for Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise in the coming months. It's all potentially subject to change depending on development factors, the game's success etc. etc., but I figured it'd be nice to give y'all a sneak peek for what to look forward to! :)

[h3]Release Plans[/h3]

[b]Bombing!! 2: A Graffiti Paradise will launch on June 27th, 2023 where it will be available for $20USD.[/b] Its release will coincide with the ending of Steam's June NEXTFest 2023.

At launch the game will feature four maps (Boardwalk, Docks, Rooftops, Subway), seven unlockable tools (Paint Can, Pen, Roller, Wheatpaste, Sponge, Eyedropper and Camera) and three pieces of gear (Stepladder, Radio, Lantern) to unlock.

[h3]Post-Launch[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43198880/62ac9e35ed927554bc1131206cbc3fecc38dd0fd.png[/img]

As you can see there's plans for three additional maps post-launch, new tools to play with and a new character in there as well.

Not pictured is various bug support, localization, and minor additions to the game (such as Enviro-Ray Presets). Throughout I'll obviously be supporting the game via bugfixes and various support.

Please keep in mind I'm just one person making this game, so these plans are just that - plans! As a solo creator my output will (naturally) be a little limited, but these are the deadlines I'm shooting for to make something cool for you to create with. There's always the potential for more additions down the road as well too! ✌️

Anyway, I hope this helps paint a pretty good picture of what to expect as development rolls forward! :)

- Devon
